rec.name: Reviews.io Star Ratings (Announcement Bar + PDP Buybox + Product Cards)
rec.status: Built — live on Green Guardia, awaiting customer feedback

what.text: Reviews.io rating data is shown as social proof in three places. (1) Announcement bar: a Reviews.io widget with a star icon, average score and review count (e.g. '4.5/5 1649+ Bewertungen'), set up for this client to show aggregated product reviews rather than shop reviews. The link to the Reviews.io company page can be switched off so the bar is display-only. (2) PDP buybox: a 'Ratings Snippet' / 'Rating Bar' block with filled stars and review count between the product title and price, plus a full 'Product Reviews Widget' app block further down the page. (3) Product cards on Home, Collection and other product listings: a custom snippet that shows each product's Reviews.io rating between the product name and the price. Clicking the stars opens the full review list (average, review count, sort, search, verified-buyer reviews, 'write a review' button).

why.text: Star ratings and review counts are among the strongest trust signals. They reduce perceived purchase risk at the moment of decision. A site-wide rating in the announcement bar builds brand credibility from the first pageview. Stars on product cards help shoppers compare and choose products while browsing. Stars in the buybox next to the price reinforce the decision at the point of purchase. Verified-buyer reviews in the pop-up add authenticity.

how.text: 1) Install Reviews.io and enable its app embed in Theme Settings > App embeds. Without this, nothing renders, even if the blocks are added in the editor. 2) Announcement bar: add the 'Reviews.io Widget' block inside the Announcement bar section. Set the keyword and widget link to the client's own Reviews.io account (check it is not a leftover URL from another store). Set text and star colors. Remove the link if the bar should not be clickable. 3) PDP: in the product template add the 'Ratings Snippet' (or 'Rating Bar') block directly under the title/price area of the buybox, and add the 'Product Reviews Widget' app block under Apps lower on the page. Each product template is separate, so repeat this for every template. 4) Product cards (Home, Collection, other listings): the theme has no native option for this, so a custom Liquid snippet renders the Reviews.io rating per product between name and price. Include the snippet in the card/product-grid templates. 5) Test on the live preview, not inside the theme customizer, which does not sync ratings correctly. If a rating still shows 0 stars, the store's sync with Reviews.io may need a test review created and approved in the Reviews.io dashboard.

items: Announcement bar widget: Widget Link (Reviews.io company page, can be disabled to make the bar non-clickable)
Aggregation source: product reviews vs. shop reviews
Per product template: Ratings Snippet / Rating Bar block position in the buybox
Per product template: Product Reviews Widget app block
Product-card rating snippet on Home / Collection / other listings (on/off)

dependencies.text: Reviews.io app installed and its app embed enabled in the theme. A Reviews.io account with synced product reviews and the correct store URL. The Focal theme, with a custom snippet for product-card ratings (not natively available). The PDP blocks must be added to every product template individually. Known gotchas: ratings may show 0 stars until the store syncs (a test review approved in Reviews.io can trigger it), and the theme customizer preview does not show ratings reliably. A review-count mismatch (e.g. 761 actual vs 81 shown) was found and fixed in the snippet.

items: Collection/Home product-card click-through rate to PDP
Bounce rate on landing pages (announcement bar effect)
Click rate on the review pop-up
